title: Born to Run
author: Christopher McDougall
summary: Christopher McDougall chases the secret of the Tarahumara runners of Mexico's Copper Canyons while asking why he keeps getting injured. He joins them for an ultramarathon and argues for barefoot-style running.
readIf: you are a runner, or you like quirky adventure with a strong argument about how humans move.
skipIf: you want a balanced scientific review of running shoes and injuries.
